verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a GraphQL Admin API reachable from POS extensions (docs-36), integration with existing software (docs-6), and built-in reporting (docs-5). Programmatic data access is therefore plausible, but nothing in the pack documents transactions or payouts endpoints, or any reconciliation or ledger-sync workflow. Missing for 10: documented transaction and payout API endpoints, daily-takings or payout reconciliation features, accounting/ledger integration (the QuickBooks item covers POS migration, not ledger sync), agent-oriented API access, and independent corroboration.
